_comment: Conservative exercise exclusions per reported limitation (and for a flagged PAR-Q+ screen). A rule can exclude whole movement patterns, exercise categories, or names matching a regex, and can cap effort. These are general precautions, not medical advice: every plan with a limitation also tells the user to follow their clinician's guidance.

notices._parq_flagged: Your health check flagged at least one item. This plan keeps effort moderate (RPE ≤ 6) and leaves out explosive and maximal lifting. Please get clearance from a doctor or physiotherapist before you start.
notices.pregnancy: Pregnancy: exercises lying on your back, twisting and jumping are left out. Follow your obstetrician's or midwife's advice, and stop if anything feels wrong.
notices.heart_condition: Heart condition: effort is capped and conditioning finishers are off. Only train with your cardiologist's approval.
notices.recent_surgery: Recent surgery: effort is capped. Follow your surgeon's or physiotherapist's return-to-training plan.
notices.default: Exercises that commonly aggravate {labels} are left out. If anything hurts, stop and substitute; pain is a signal, not a challenge.
notices._health_unknown: You haven't shared health information, so this plan stays moderate (RPE ≤ 7, no explosive or maximal lifting). If you have any medical condition, check with a doctor before starting.
